needs: commands.test set to `npm test` in .factory/sandbox/manifest.json, so `bsf gates tests` runs this repo's new suite and `bsf gates coverage` reads the coverage/lcov.info it writes. The manifest still says commands.test: null and capabilities.not_exercised still lists "Automated tests and total coverage" with the reason "the repo has no test framework, no test files and no test script" — as of this PR that is no longer true. runbook.md's "## Test" section ("This repo has no tests.") needs the same correction.
why: This PR adds node --test as the runner plus 31 tests over src/, and `npm test` exits 0 writing coverage/lcov.info at 98.04% line coverage. I ran it by hand in the sandbox and it works, so no acceptance check was blocked. But the gates cannot see it: commands.test resolves to `none`, so the tests gate reports neutral and the coverage gate finds no report. .factory/sandbox/** is a protected path that the gardening pipeline may not change, so the builder could not wire this up itself — it needs an amendment episode. Until then the suite is green but ungated, and a later change could break it without any gate noticing.
